name: SKAAPSTERT Kos-en-Koffiestal
address: 7 Amy Searle St, Central, Great Brak River, 6525, South Africa
description_short: Homely Great Brak River spot serving hearty South African comfort food with legendary lamb's tail potjie.
description_long:
SKAAPSTERT Kos-en-Koffiestal brings proper South African home cooking to Great Brak River, with a name that celebrates one of the country's most traditional dishes. This warm, unpretentious eatery on Amy Searle Street has built a devoted following for its generous portions and honest flavours that remind you of Sunday lunch at ouma's house.

The menu showcases classic South African fare done right — think hearty potjies, traditional bredie, and comfort food that hits the spot after a day exploring the Garden Route. The lamb's tail stew is a standout, slow-cooked to tender perfection. It's the kind of place where regulars greet each other by name and first-timers quickly feel at home.

Tucked in the heart of Great Brak River between Mossel Bay and George, SKAAPSTERT offers a genuine taste of local hospitality. The casual atmosphere and wallet-friendly prices make it ideal for families and anyone craving authentic South African cooking without the fuss.
